title: Bay Tribune: "Evacuating NICU to Houston?"

fields.subject: Mariner Bay — evacuating NICU to Houston? — deadline 9 PM
fields.body:
Good morning,

I'm working on a Quinlan story for tonight's web edition and tomorrow's paper. My deadline is 9:00 PM today.

A post in the Facebook group "CC NICU Parents Support" has been shared about 1,140 times since early this morning. It reads, quote:

"CONFIRMED by a nurse — Mariner Bay is flying ALL babies to Houston tonight, parents NOT allowed on the helicopter, and they're 14 nurses short so they can't keep them. #Quinlan #MarinerBay #CorpusChristi"

The post is from @JessRamosCC and includes a photo of your NICU entrance sign. A screenshot is attached.

Can you confirm:
1. How many infants are being moved out of the NICU, if any?
2. Where are they going? Is it Houston?
3. Will parents be allowed to go with their babies?
4. Is the hospital short of nurses for the storm, and if so, by how many?

I've also asked Nueces County OEM about Zone B. If you can't answer everything, I'd still like an on-the-record statement before 9. I can take a call at any time today.

Thanks,

Attachment: JessRamosCC_post_screenshot.png (412 KB)

instructorNote: This tests rumor control. The IC should have the PIO draft a holding statement for the IC to clear. The statement should say there are no Houston transfers and no final decision before the midnight deadline, say families will be contacted directly, and leave out infant counts and staffing gaps until the CNO and the Transfer Center Liaison agree on the numbers. Watch whether the IC asks if this calls for a public statement outside the usual 6-hour schedule, and whether anyone confirms the nurse shortage on the record.
